bandReport.notes: Band covers p13-p16; p16 is the last page of the booklet (0-based p00-p16) and Q100 is present and complete, so the paper ends at 100 items. Seam with b3: p12 carries Q76-Q80, all data-sufficiency items ('Question: / Statement I: / Statement II:') whose Directions block starts before p12 - b3 owns them, none transcribed here. Q80 is complete on p12 (Question + Statement I + Statement II); nothing straddles the p12/p13 seam, and p13 opens cleanly with a fresh 'Consider the following data for the next two (02) items' block. Five stimulus blocks start inside this band and are owned in full here: D81-82 (table, p13), D83-84 (table, p13), D91-93 (figure, opens p14 right column, third member Q93 on p15), D94-96 (figure, opens p15 left column, members Q94 p15 left / Q95-Q96 p15 right), D97-98 (figure, opens p15 right column, both members on p16 left), D99-100 (figure, opens p16 right column, both members on p16). Four printed figures found in this band (D91-93 triangle-and-circle, D94-96 circle-in-square PQRS, D97-98 rectangle-in-circle, D99-100 triangle-in-circle) - all four sit in the closing geometry region as expected. Two printed data tables found (D81-82 and D83-84), both rendered as GFM pipe tables. No misprints found; no unreadable glyphs; every option was read off the page per label, and Q95/Q96/Q97/Q98 option sets were re-checked at 6-7x from the source PDF because their coefficients differ only subtly. No invented subtopics - every chapter and subtopic used is listed in catalog.json.

The plinth of a house has an area of 200 square metres. It is rectangular in shape and its length and breadth are in the ratio \(2 : 1\). The owner of the house extends the terrace by 1 m on each side. What is the percentage of area that has increased in the terrace relative to the plinth ?

A square sheet of side length 44 cm is rolled along one of its sides to form a cylinder by making opposite edges just to touch each other. What is the volume of the cylinder ? (Take \(\pi = \frac{22}{7}\))
The volume of a cuboid is 3600 cubic cm. The areas of two adjacent faces are 225 square cm and 144 square cm. What is the area of the other adjacent face ?
The perimeter and the area of a right-angled triangle are 36 cm and 54 square cm respectively. What is the length of the hypotenuse ?

Let
\(X = \{x \mid x = 2 + 4k, \text{ where } k = 0,\ 1,\ 2,\ 3, \ldots 24\}\).
Let S be a subset of X such that the sum of no two elements of S is 100. What is the maximum possible number of elements in S ?
